args.task: The CLI refuses an unknown flag and an unknown value of an enumerable flag before doing anything, naming the flag, the value and the allowed values (#266).
acceptance: every command and alias in contract/surface.json, given --definitely-not-a-flag, exits non-zero, names the flag on stderr and writes nothing into its --dir

every flag the surface records with options — and at least init preset, init ai, init review, attach ai and mutate judge format — given the value not-a-value exits non-zero, names the flag, the value and every allowed value on stderr, and writes nothing
mutate judge --format junit is refused naming format, junit, vitest-json and junit-xml on stderr, never as "the report is not JSON"

witnesses.criterion: every command and alias in contract/surface.json, given --definitely-not-a-flag, exits non-zero, names the flag on stderr and writes nothing into its --dir
witnesses.command: node -e 'const {spawnSync}=require("node:child_process");const fs=require("node:fs");const os=require("node:os");const path=require("node:path");const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("contract/surface.json","utf8"));const bad=[];for(const name of Object.keys(s.commands)){const D=fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(),"w266-"));const r=spawnSync("pnpm",["exec","tsx","src/cli.ts",...name.split(" "),"--dir",D,"--definitely-not-a-flag"],{encoding:"utf8",env:{...process.env,NO_COLOR:"1"}});if(r.status===0||!r.stderr.includes("definitely-not-a-flag")||fs.readdirSync(D).length>0)bad.push(name+" exit="+r.status)}if(Object.keys(s.commands).length<10||bad.length>0){console.error(bad.join("\n"));process.exit(1)}'

witnesses.criterion: every flag the surface records with options — and at least init preset, init ai, init review, attach ai and mutate judge format — given the value not-a-value exits non-zero, names the flag, the value and every allowed value on stderr, and writes nothing
witnesses.command: node -e 'const {spawnSync}=require("node:child_process");const fs=require("node:fs");const os=require("node:os");const path=require("node:path");const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("contract/surface.json","utf8"));const en=[];for(const [name,c] of Object.entries(s.commands))for(const [flag,d] of Object.entries(c.flags||{}))if(Array.isArray(d.options))en.push([name,flag,d.options]);const have=new Set(en.map(([n,f])=>n+" "+f));const floor=["init preset","init ai","init review","attach ai","mutate judge format"].filter(k=>!have.has(k));const bad=[];for(const [name,flag,options] of en){const D=fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(),"w266-"));const r=spawnSync("pnpm",["exec","tsx","src/cli.ts",...name.split(" "),"--dir",D,"--"+flag,"not-a-value"],{encoding:"utf8",env:{...process.env,NO_COLOR:"1"}});if(r.status===0||!r.stderr.includes(flag)||!r.stderr.includes("not-a-value")||!options.every(o=>r.stderr.includes(o))||fs.readdirSync(D).length>0)bad.push(name+" --"+flag+" exit="+r.status)}if(floor.length>0||bad.length>0){console.error("missing from the surface: "+floor.join(", ")+"\n"+bad.join("\n"));process.exit(1)}'

witnesses.criterion: mutate judge --format junit is refused naming format, junit, vitest-json and junit-xml on stderr, never as "the report is not JSON"
witnesses.command: D=$(mktemp -d) && printf "<testsuite timestamp=\"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z\"><testcase name=\"t\" file=\"a.py\"/></testsuite>" > $D.xml && NO_COLOR=1 pnpm exec tsx src/cli.ts mutate judge --dir $D --baseline --format junit --report $D.xml > $D.out 2> $D.err; s=$?; node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs");const e=fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8");if(process.argv[3]==="0"||!["format","junit","vitest-json","junit-xml"].every(t=>e.includes(t))||e.includes("not JSON")||fs.readdirSync(process.argv[2]).length>0){console.error(e);process.exit(1)}' $D.err $D $s
